releaseNotes: DukanBILL Desktop v1.9.25 — Refined 2-Tier Navigation Bar: Introduces an uncluttered, responsive dual-tier header system matching modern ERP standards. Tier 1 cleanly separates Brand identity and Operator profile controls (Settings, User Badge, More Actions menu); Tier 2 provides a dedicated navigation ribbon with keyboard shortcuts (F1-F8) and zero window clipping on all display sizes.
